title: Version 2.1.183 - Enhanced Auto Mode Safety and Security Improvements
description: Improved auto mode safety by blocking destructive git commands when unintended, added deprecation warnings for outdated models, new attribution setting, and multiple bug fixes including terminal corruption, WebSearch issues, and improved TUI stability.

community_feedback.quote: Tell HN: I'm 60 years old. Claude Code has re-ignited a passion
Code Review for Claude Code - 84% of heavily Claude-driven PRs had around 7.5 bugs worthy issues

title: Version 0.141.0 - Remote Executor Encryption and Cross-Platform Enhancements
description: Remote executors now use authenticated, end-to-end encrypted Noise relay channels. Cross-platform remote execution preserves executor-native working directories and shells. Selected executor plugins can activate stdio MCP servers per thread. Added real-time speech append control and TUI input auto-resolution with countdown.

community_feedback.quote: Users praised the slick permissions workflow and background browser testing feature

title: Consumer Shutdown Announced - Gemini Code Assist Deprecated
description: Google announces shutdown of Gemini CLI and Gemini Code Assist for consumers. Shutdown began June 18, 2026 for GitHub integration with full shutdown scheduled for July 17, 2026. Gemini Code Assist for Google AI Pro and Ultra stopped serving requests on June 18, 2026.

title: Version 2.1.181 - Config Syntax and Runtime Upgrades
description: Added /config key=value syntax, sandbox.allowAppleEvents opt-in setting, CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE env var, upgraded bundled Bun runtime to 1.4, improved streaming performance, and fixed numerous issues including network drive file operations and startup performance.

title: Version 2.1.179 - Connection Drop Recovery and UI Fixes
description: Fixed mid-stream connection drops with partial response preservation, improved mouse-wheel scrolling in WSL2, sandbox performance improvements, and fixed feedback survey behavior.

title: Version 2.1.178 - Agent Teams Simplification
description: Removed TeamCreate and TeamDelete tools - now every session has one implicit team. Added Tool(param:value) permission syntax, improved nested .claude/ directory handling, enhanced auto mode safety, and /doctor improvements.

title: Version 3.2.16 - Multi-File Editing Improvements
description: Enhanced multi-file editing capabilities, improved context awareness across files, and added performance optimizations for larger codebases.

community_feedback.quote: Windsurf is now Devin Desktop - community discussing the rebrand

title: Version 0.140.0 - Usage Views, Goal Preservation, and Claude Code Import
description: Added /usage views for daily, weekly, and cumulative account token activity. /goal now preserves oversized text, large pasted blocks, and image attachments. Added permanent session deletion through codex delete. Added /import for selectively importing setup from Claude Code. Managed Amazon Bedrock API-key authentication added.

title: Automate Skill with GitHub and Slack Triggers
description: Introduced /automate skill allowing users to create automated workflows triggered by GitHub events (pull requests, issues, commits) and Slack notifications. Enables cloud-based autonomous agents for continuous integration workflows.

community_feedback.quote: Users creating custom skills for Cursor agents to automate workflows, some spending over $50k developing 12 custom skills

title: Version 2.1.176 - Localization and Credential Caching
description: Session titles now generated in conversation language, added footerLinksRegexes setting, improved Bedrock credential caching, fixed auto mode on Fable 5, and resolved permission rule matching issues.

title: Usage-Based Billing and Copilot Max Launch
description: Major pricing model change from request-based to usage-based billing with AI Credits as primary metric. Copilot code reviews now consume GitHub Actions minutes. Added Copilot Max upgrade for power users with higher included usage and spending limits.

community_feedback.quote: End of an Era - My costs effectively went up 30X in one day
AI costs how much? - Users react to new usage-based pricing system
Devs Sound Off - You Will Get Less But Pay the Same Price

title: Version 2.1.175 - Enterprise Model Enforcement
description: Added enforceAvailableModels managed setting for enterprises to constrain Default model and prevent user settings from widening allowlists.

title: Version 3.1.7 - Context Window Expansion
description: Expanded context window for better understanding of larger codebases, improved memory efficiency, and enhanced code navigation features.

title: Version 2.1.174 - Scrolling and Model Picker Improvements
description: Added wheelScrollAccelerationEnabled setting, fixed /model picker hiding model family rows, resolved Bedrock GovCloud region issues, and improved background session behavior.

title: Version 0.139.0 - Code Mode Web Search and Plugin Marketplace
description: Code mode can now call standalone web search directly. Tool and connector input schemas preserve oneOf and allOf. Plugin marketplace automation more informative with machine-readable list output including marketplace sources. MCP startup warnings from subagents stay in their thread.

title: Version 2.1.173 - Fable 5 Model Name Normalization
description: Fixed Fable 5 model names with [1m] suffix not being normalized, resolved spurious sandbox dependencies warning on Windows.

title: Version 0.138.0 - Desktop Handoff and Image Path Exposure
description: The /app command can hand off CLI threads into Codex Desktop on macOS and Windows. Local image attachments expose saved file paths to the model for reliable follow-up edits. Reasoning effort selection more flexible with TUI fallback shortcuts.

title: Version 3.0.28 - Terminal Integration Enhancements
description: Improved terminal integration with better command execution tracking, enhanced shell session management, and fixed terminal output parsing issues.
